title: Agent Page Extract input
description: Turn public URLs into clean, LLM-ready Markdown or text.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Pages to extract. Each item is a URL string or an object with a url field.

crawlDepth.title: Crawl depth
crawlDepth.description: How many same-host link hops to follow. 0 extracts only the URLs you provide. Maximum 2.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: Stop after this many pages (including empty, blocked, and error rows). Default 10. Hard cap 200.

includeLinks.title: Include links
includeLinks.description: Add the links found in the extracted article to each dataset row.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: markdown, plain text, or both. Word count and the token estimate always use the plain article text.

removeSelectors.title: Extra CSS selectors to remove
removeSelectors.description: Optional CSS selectors removed before main-content extraction, in addition to nav, footer, ads, and cookie banners.

useBrowserFallback.title: Browser fallback
useBrowserFallback.description: When a cheap fetch is empty or still a JavaScript shell, render it once in Chrome. Turn off to stay on Cheerio only.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip URLs disallowed by robots.txt and mark them blocked. On by default.
